seo.title: De Paardendrogist: AI-automated Meta sales (Advantage+) - +404% peak revenue, ROAS >18 (2024)
seo.meta_description: With scandiweb, Dutch retailer De Paardendrogist restructured its Meta account around Advantage+ Shopping: +111% revenue, +404% at the November peak and a ROAS above 18.
seo.resume_citable: In 2024, Dutch e-commerce retailer De Paardendrogist grew revenue by 111% (and +404% at the November peak, ROAS above 18) by restructuring its Meta account around Advantage+ Shopping campaigns and geographic targeting, across the Netherlands, Belgium, and Germany.

faq.q: Which AI tool did De Paardendrogist use?
faq.a: Meta Advantage+ Shopping, which manages audiences, placements, and creative from the catalog, combined with boosted posts and geographic targeting.

faq.q: Is the result incremental or attributed?
faq.a: Attributed: the figures come from the agency scandiweb (revenue and ROAS measured on the account), with no incrementality study published for this case.

pattern: AI-automated sales campaign combined with geographic targeting and boosted posts, within a restructured account
objectif_business: Restructure the Meta account to better allocate budget, grow revenue on the private-label products, and hold a ROAS of at least 10.
description: De Paardendrogist, a Dutch e-commerce retailer of horse care products with more than 30 years of history, restructured its Meta account with the agency scandiweb. The setup relies on Advantage+ Shopping campaigns, where the AI chooses audiences, placements, and creative from the product catalog, combined with boosted posts, retargeting, and geographic targeting focused on areas with a high density of horse farms, in the Netherlands, Belgium, and Germany. The formats tested range from a simple visual to catalog carousels and collection ads. Advantage+ Shopping and boosted posts together drove 45 percent of Meta revenue. The restructuring raised revenue by 111.2 percent, with a conversion rate up 30 percent. At the November 2024 peak compared to November 2023, revenue jumped 404 percent and overall ROAS exceeded 18, particularly strong in the Dutch market.

Meta Advantage+ Shopping plus boosted posts, retargeting, and geographic targeting.

Evidence level B, status confirmed, project run with the agency scandiweb.

niveau_preuve.justification: Two quantified case studies from the integrator that ran the project (scandiweb), consistent on the same brand and the same Advantage+ setup; published by the agency, without primary or independent press corroboration.

stack_technique.detail: automated sales campaign: audiences, bids, placements, and creative driven by Meta ML from the catalog
purchase reporting, the signal that lets the algorithm hold the ROAS target of at least 10
rules that adjust spend based on an external factor, here the weather that affects demand for equine products
e-commerce agency that restructured the account and manages the campaigns

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Continuous delivery, with a ramp-up at the seasonal November peak; automatic rules to adjust spend based on the weather, which weighs on demand for equine products.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: The agency scandiweb with the De Paardendrogist team.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The purchases reported by Meta tracking and the ROAS target of at least 10. If the purchase signal is missing, the algorithm optimizes poorly and ROAS drops.

etapes.detail: Reorganization of the campaigns for better budget allocation between Advantage+ Shopping, boosted posts, and retargeting.
Advantage+ Shopping chooses audiences, placements, and creative from the catalog. Formats tested: simple visual, catalog carousels, collection ads.

etapes.etape: Target equine areas and manage the weather
etapes.detail: Geographic targeting on regions with a high density of horse farms, with automatic rules that adjust spend based on the weather.

prerequis_data: Reliable Meta purchase tracking (Pixel + Conversions API)
Geographic data to target high-demand areas
prerequis_orga: A Meta account to restructure in order to reallocate budget
Automatic rules to manage spend based on an external factor (here the weather)
replication.premiere_etape: Restructure the account around an Advantage+ Shopping campaign and geographic targeting, with a clear ROAS target to defend.

playbook.action: Audit and restructure the account: budget allocation between Advantage+ Shopping, boosted posts, and retargeting.
playbook.livrable: New account plan with budget split

playbook.action: Make the catalog feed and purchase measurement reliable (Pixel + Conversions API).
playbook.livrable: Validated purchase tracking in Events Manager

playbook.action: Launch Advantage+ Shopping with a clear ROAS target and geographic targeting on high-demand areas.
playbook.livrable: Campaigns active in the target markets

playbook.action: Let the learning phase converge and test the formats (simple visual, catalog carousel, collection ads).
playbook.livrable: Winning formats identified by cost and ROAS

playbook.action: Set the automatic rules on the relevant external factor (here the weather) and read revenue, conversion, and ROAS.
playbook.livrable: Documented management and budget reallocated to what performs

replication.equipe: 1 media buyer (in-house or agency) + dev access for the feed and the Conversions API

statut_vivant.note: De Paardendrogist remains an active e-commerce retailer and Advantage+ Shopping is Meta's default sales format; scandiweb remains an e-commerce partner, which secures the durability of the pattern.

transposable_ue.note: A case already deployed in the Netherlands, Belgium, and Germany, hence in a GDPR/ePrivacy environment. It relies on the product catalog and Meta purchase tracking; activation is subject to consent. Manual geographic targeting stays under the advertiser's control. Limited AI Act risk.
